_doc: The vocabulary of the active crew abilities (docs/CONTENT.md section 16), read by scripts/crew/crew_abilities.gd. A crew member carries one as `ability: {id, cooldown?, params?}`, on their species entry (data/species.json) or on a character (data/characters.json); `cooldown` (seconds, counted from the use) and `params` override the defaults below, key by key. Select the member (left click, or their crew card) and press G. The cooldown ticks in game time, so it stands still while build mode pauses the world. Per ability: name and blurb for the UI, tag (two letters) and color for the crew card, cooldown, params (all numbers except `families`). What each does: power_system: the system next to them gets +power (added to its figure, like a station bonus) for duration s, no reactor needed. overclock: the system they man runs mult times faster (engine thrust, reactor output, weapon and shield recharge speed, helm bonus) for duration s, then is offline for rest s. heal_burst: everyone in their room gets amount hp (times their heal_others work speed: a Basalt heals half). rally: the others in their room work mult times faster for duration s. repair_burst: amount hp back on the most hurt system next to them (a disabled one works again). extinguish: every fire in their room goes out. seal_breach: the nearest count breached walls within range cells are sealed at once. shield_layer: +layers shield layers for duration s (needs a working shield). scan: for duration s the radar sees hidden contacts, and the use reports the enemy's state. hack: needs them at the helm and an enemy: the first working system of the enemy's `families` (in order) is offline for duration s. berserk: their melee damage is multiplied by mult for duration s (nothing reads it until on-foot fights). phase: they step through the wall in front of them (within range cells) into the next room.

power_system.name: Hand Power
power_system.blurb: Powers the system next to them by hand.

overclock.name: Overclock
overclock.blurb: The system they man runs faster, then burns out.

heal_burst.name: Heal Burst
heal_burst.blurb: Heals everyone in the room at once.

rally.name: Rally
rally.blurb: The others in the room work faster.

repair_burst.name: Quick Fix
repair_burst.blurb: Mends the hurt system next to them on the spot.

extinguish.name: Smother
extinguish.blurb: Puts out every fire in the room.

seal_breach.name: Seal Breach
seal_breach.blurb: Seals the nearest breach at once.

shield_layer.name: Bulwark
shield_layer.blurb: One more shield layer for a while.

scan.name: Scan
scan.blurb: Reveals the enemy, and hidden contacts on the radar.

hack.name: Hack
hack.blurb: From the helm: knocks an enemy system offline.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.blurb: Hits twice as hard in a melee.

phase.name: Phase
phase.blurb: Steps through the wall ahead into the next room.
